question: Who among the following is the author of the book, ‘Unfinished: A Memoir’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Priyanka Chopra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Priyanka Chopra** is the author of the book '**Unfinished: A Memoir**'.
 
• The memoir provides an intimate look into Chopra's life, her journey in the entertainment industry, and her personal experiences.
 
• Priyanka Chopra is a renowned Indian actress, singer, and film producer who has gained international fame.
 
• 'Unfinished' was published in **February 2021 **and has received positive reviews from readers and critics alike.
 
• The book covers various aspects of her life, including her childhood, her career in Bollywood and Hollywood, and her philanthropic efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Priyanka Chopra** was crowned **Miss World in 2000**, which marked the beginning of her successful career in the entertainment industry.
 
• She has received numerous awards for her work in films, including **National Film Awards **and Filmfare Awards.
 
• In addition to her acting career, Chopra is known for her humanitarian work and has been appointed as a **UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador**.
 
• 'Unfinished' also delves into her marriage to American singer Nick Jonas and their life together.
 
• The memoir is a testament to Chopra's resilience, determination, and multifaceted talents.
